# Ankate Consulting Ltd

> HR consultancy in Ruiru, Kenya. Recruitment, payroll and HR administration, compliance advisory, training and performance, outsourced HR and HR policies for growing organisations in Kenya. Founded and led by CHRP Annmary K. Mutegi, a Certified Human Resource Professional with 10+ years of experience and a registered member of IHRM Kenya. Office hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 am to 5:00 pm; Saturday, 8:00 am to 5:00 pm. Serves organisations across all of Kenya.
